reviews.author: Garland Hanton
reviews.text: Best prices and service in town. Ordered tires on Monday and they came in on Tuesday morning. Went and had tires installed and was out in an hour! What else can you ask for? I will be dealing with them and YOU should too I had absolutely NO PROBLEMS!!!! Thanks A-1 see y’all soon

reviews.author: Ms.
reviews.text: I will never come back to this place again! After being a loyal customer for years, I was treated with complete disrespect. Their service is unprofessional, and they don't take responsibility for their mistakes. I trusted them to work on my car, and twice they messed things up, then charged me to fix the issues they caused. If you're considering going here for alignment work, don't do it! They will mess up your car and make things worse instead of fixing them properly. It's frustrating to deal with such carelessness and dishonesty. Save yourself the trouble and go somewhere else. This shop does not value its customers, and they've lost me as one for good!"

reviews.author: cece asbury
reviews.text: Jason is an amazing worker and also very friendly… Him & everyone did great today and they have excellent customer service skills. Thank you for everything! and fixing the problem with my car

reviews.author: Fernanda
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I broke down on the highway while passing through the area, not only did A1 Rodriguez send someone to pick us up, they even kept the shop open a little longer to help us out. I have never had such a good experience at a mechanic shop before, everyone was incredibly helpful and explained everything very well. The prices were also incredibly fair. I highly suggest this auto shop to anyone, my only regret is that I wish they were located in my city so I could make them my go-to mechanics.

reviews.author: Jasmine Willis
reviews.text: Found my new auto care techs. The staff here are awesome, knowledgeable and efficient. 2/4/24 update BUYER BEWARE. Don’t go here. after picking my car up from this shop for repairs it broke down shortly after leaving on the way home.

reviews.author: Marshaé Smith
reviews.text: As I move away from allowing my dealer to service my vehicle, A1 Rodriguez has been my go-to company and they take such good care of me and my baby. They’re kind, quick and, most importantly, affordably priced. With each visit, I save at least $300-$400 by doing business with them instead of the Honda Dealerships. They operate in integrity and never try to get over on me by upselling or overselling me on services that I don’t need. This last time, they even informed me that two of the services recommended by my dealership’s service department weren’t even needed, and that honestly alone saved me a couple hundred dollars. Leti, Carlos and their mechanics are great. I appreciate them so much and will continue to travel 2 hours from Charlotte, NC to allow them to device my vehicle. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Jeff Marandi
reviews.text: If your car needs small peripheral repair (tire, CV joint, axles, breaks, and so on) this shop may be able to do it. But for heavy stuff like engine & transmission repair this place is not reliable at all. Their mechanic "R." has a very shallow knowledge of engine repairs, but never admits his limited knowledge and gets offended and displays a rude behavior when you question his diagnosis. They gave me runaround for over a moth for the engine repair and more than 3 different diagnosis, the last one being total engine replacement which would exceeded the price of my car. In short they may charge a little less but their workmanship and professionalism are questionable.

reviews.author: Tracey Jenkins
reviews.text: I am beyond grateful to these folks! My car broke down on the highway as I was traveling home to Charlotte and a kind young man stopped to help. He suggested we take my car A1 Rodriguez, even gave me their contact info. I was in such a state that I literally gave them my keys and my car and left town. Not only did they repair the problem, they fixed a couple of other issues as well. Their price was far better than anything I would’ve gotten in Charlotte. Thanks Lette, you guys are fantastic!

reviews.author: Lami Adama
reviews.text: I am giving this folks 1 star because there is no provision for zero. I towed my car there and after their fake diagnostic, they gave me $1800 price for fixing my car's Timing Belt. They requested for $700 deposit which I gave them without hesitation. However, they turned around and told me it would take 3weeks to fix my car. I went to auto zone to price Timing Belt and the price was $49.99 but this thieves told me $400. Long story short, when I insisted I was not going to wait for 3 weeks, the owner's wife called me and said "We are not fixing your car, come and take your deposit ". I had to get my AAA to tow it from their workshop to another place. The new mechanic fixed it in 2 days and charged me $420 which includes price for Timing $49.99 and the rest money for labor. Please if you don't want to be duped, then AVOID A1 RODRIGUEZ. They are rude, dishonest, uneducated, and thieves. BE WARNED!

reviews.author: Lisa Lucas
reviews.text: Been doing business with A-1 Rodriguez for many years and I've never been disappointed. Always a friendly face to greet you and excellent service.

reviews.author: Kattie Lynn Cramer
reviews.text: They get it done! Expert alignments and a great time. Wonderful customer service. Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Thank you for your exuberant hard work in the heat!

reviews.author: Willie Griffin
reviews.text: I went to This place because I had a leak in my power steering hose, they checked it out and determined that I had a problem with my power steering pump, so I dicided to have them replace it as well, THE JOB CAME WITH A YEAR WARRANTY ON PARTS AND LABOR, AFTER CONSTANT LEAKAGE OF MY POWER STEERING PUMP I DECIDED TO GO BACK ON 1/31,/22 AND THE WORK WAS DONE ON 6/4/21 CLEARLY WITHIN THE Warranty Period and THEY REFUSED TO HONOR IT.DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE, IT IS THE WORST SHOP IN ORANGEBURG SC, THEY DO NOT HONOR THEIR WARRANTY EVEN IF YOU HAVE IT IN WRITING.As you can see with all their responses they will not take responsibility for their own actions, They failed to Mention that they would not Check my vehicle out and actually told me to get out of their their shop. I STAND BY EVERYTHING THAT I HAVE STATED.

reviews.author: Malik Chestnut
reviews.text: Definitely recommend!!! They were very helpful friendly and cost efficient! Will not hustle you or tell anything that isn’t needed with vehicles unlike any other place I’ve been Orangeburg or otherwise!

reviews.author: Sara B
reviews.text: Have to say Thank you so much! Our vehicle broke down on our way home to New York. You guys came as soon as possible and even sent us a helping hand. We made it home with our Marine. Again, I thank you and my family thanks you!

reviews.author: Scott Davis
reviews.text: Bought 4 brand new tires here. Left and realized that something was amiss. Contacted them and was told I could come by and have them re balanced. A few days later when I showed up I was confronted with attitude and told I had to pay to have them balanced as they had already did it once. I left Took it down the road and paid someone else to rebalance them. Come to find out there was not one weight on the tires at all! Hence they were never balanced to begin with. Maybe this was just a one off but I get the feeling that this is a common thing with them. I recommend paying a few dollars extra and going elsewhere.

reviews.author: Barbara Kiser
reviews.text: This has been our family's go-to service station for more than a decade. If they can't fix it - they'll send you to someone that can! Very trustworthy & reliable!

reviews.author: Butterfly Kiss
reviews.text: I'm so glad I got recommended to this place. Letti will give the shirt off her back to help who she can and they are very affordable

reviews.author: Desi Lane
reviews.text: If this isn't allowed please delete. WE WENT TO A1 Rodriguez yesterday afternoon on North road in Orangeburg. To get a tire changed on our 17 in rims. The owner and one of his helpers decided it was cool to beat it with a sledge hammer and hit the rim which bent it. Which we were unaware of at the time. He "fixed "it . by the time we madeit home it was flat. Called him around 5:30 he told is come back He would be open. When we go there areound 6:08 or so. He was in there but wouldn't open the door we Sat outside for 30 mins.with our sick child. The boss peeped out the window a few time would open door. We went home contacted him this morning once again to see if he could fix his mistake .HE WAS PISSED. CUSSING AT MY HUSBAND RIGHT IN FRONT OF OUR 4 year old son. Which you can't understand anything he said anyway but besides the point. He did his best to argue my husband down about his mistake.. Finally after all the cussing and showing out UTS FINALLY DONE...... MORAL OF THE STORY IS BAD BUSINESS WILL GET TOU SHUT DOWN. BE CAUTIOUS AND NEVER LET ANYONE PUSH YOU OVER. OH AND IF YOU CAN FIND A DIFFERNT BODY SHOP IT WOULD BE BEST

reviews.author: Tammy Johnson
reviews.text: I didn't have to wait long was in and out. I've never had a problem with the service I received there. I keep returning .

reviews.author: Mark Richter
reviews.text: Found a part I'd been looking for two years, got my 1935 back on the road , I'd missed driving her.Greatvservice and customer service and support.

reviews.author: R Thomas
reviews.text: Best place and Prices in town to get your car fixed. If anything is wrong with your vehicle bring it to A1 Rodriguez, they will take care of you.

reviews.author: J Rivera
reviews.text: Lette and the guys are amazing. Ac systems, and brakes are amazing. They are my go to when I cant resolve an issue

reviews.author: Keicha waiters
reviews.text: I always take my vehicles there. Prices are responsible, fair and honest people that go above and beyond to help.

reviews.author: Gloria Jean Dash
reviews.text: Service not good I DID NOT PLACE THIS REVIEW. Y’ALL HAVE SERVICE MY VEHICLES MANY TIMES, FAMILY AND FRIENDS.

reviews.author: Gretta Jackson
reviews.text: The people there are knowledgeable about automobiles and everybody is in sync with each other. And you can tell that they love what they do.

reviews.author: Kris Litman-Koon
reviews.text: They were tremendously helpful and understanding when my car broke down when I was driving through their city.
